{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = sales_df.isnull().sum()

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = sales_df.duplicated().sum()

# Check the distribution of customer_segment
segment_counts = sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts()

# Check the distribution of status
status_counts = sales_df['status'].value_counts()

# Check the distribution of revenue
revenue_summary = sales_df['revenue'].describe()

missing_values, duplicates, segment_counts, status_counts, revenue_summary"}
